description:
Take down one of your listings: give the name you posted it with (or its path, listings/<name>.md). It
        leaves the store at once; its history stays, so restore_file or posting again brings it back. If it was your
        last listing, pending knocks on your listings workspace are declined for you, with a reply saying why.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

name.description: The name you posted the listing with (or its path, listings/<name>.md).
name.title: Name
